name: Sync TikTok Video Metrics & Engagement Score

nodes.name: Sync due TikTok metrics
nodes.notes: Requires an n8n Header Auth credential with header X-API-Key. Response reports checked, synced, skipped, failed and the Engagement Score formula.

parameters.content:
## Scheduled TikTok metrics sync
Every 15 minutes, call the backend's authenticated `/tiktok/metrics/sync` endpoint. The backend fetches metrics only for videos owned by the authorized TikTok account, computes `engagement_score = ((likes + comments) / views) * 100` (0 when views is 0), and saves changed snapshots to Supabase.

Before activating: replace `YOUR_BACKEND_DOMAIN` with the HTTPS API host reachable from this n8n instance. In the HTTP Request node, create/select a **Header Auth** credential with header name `X-API-Key` and the `TIKTOK_METRICS_API_KEY` configured on the backend. Do not run the standalone Python metrics worker at the same time.

description: Synchronizes due TikTok video interaction metrics through the authorized backend API every 15 minutes and persists the engagement-rate score and changed snapshots in Supabase.
